verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents release notes, a changelog, or versioned update notes for Caveman's skills. The "before, after and why" change summaries (docs-8) describe the agent's work reviews, and the audit log (docs-20) tracks admin changes. Both are adjacent features, not release changelogs.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
